newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Eight rebels die in Colombian firefight.
newsitem.headline: Eight rebels die in Colombian firefight.

text.p: At least eight leftist guerrillas died in fighting with counterinsurgency troops in western Colombia early on Wednesday, army sources said.
The battle between the army and a group of National Liberation Army (ELN) rebels broke out just after dawn in a remote area of Risaralda province, Col. Diego Alberto Gutierrez told reporters.

"The combat took place in a remote area of the province about three hours from the town of Mistrato. We killed eight narco-subversives and seized equipment," Gutierrez said, adding that no soldiers were injured.
The ELN, Colombia's second largest guerrilla army, is a Cuban-inspired force set up by radical Roman Catholic priests in the mid-1960s.
